title: WorkerResult
description: What a Worker produces. Schema-validated before it is allowed to become state, and still not trusted until a Verifier passes it — validation proves the shape is right, verification proves the work is right.

status.description: 'produced' means the worker believes it did the work — a claim for the verifier to test, not a conclusion. 'blocked' means it could not proceed and is saying so instead of inventing a diff.

summary.description: What was done, in the worker's own words. Never used as evidence — only for humans reading the event log.

diff.description: Unified diff to apply. Required when status is 'produced'.

blocked_reason.description: Required when status is 'blocked'. A worker that cannot proceed must say why rather than produce plausible nonsense.
